rows.definition: Input field on the #4801 ReservationEnvelope recording that a real NCCL collective smoke test passed across the exact reserved GPU ranks, before any artifact transfer begins.
rows.distinction: It is an INPUT carrying independent hardware evidence, never a value the placement gate derives; progresswitnessed tracks loop progress in software, whereas this records a collective result on reserved accelerator ranks.

rows.definition: The #4801 typed refusal verdict returned when every resource bar clears but no NCCL collective has been proven across the exact reserved ranks.
rows.distinction: It is the VERDICT constant naming the refusal, whereas CollectiveWitnessed is the boolean input the verdict is derived from.

rows.definition: The wire/JSON string value of the #4801 ReservationCollectiveUnwitnessed verdict, consumed by #4788 to gate the artifact transfer.
rows.distinction: It is the serialized token a consumer switches on; ReservationCollectiveUnwitnessed is the Go identifier that carries it.

rows.definition: The #4801 typed refusal verdict returned when accelerator memory reachable WITHOUT evicting any peer workload is below the artifact size plus runtime headroom.
rows.distinction: It describes capacity bounded by a no-eviction constraint, so it is refused rather than solved by eviction; the evict family's other terms name mechanisms that DO evict, whereas this names a bar measured precisely by declining to.

rows.definition: Unexported constructor returning the #4801 candidate reservation exactly as directly witnessed: the non-evicting reach read back from the lab GPU nodes, scrubbed to a node-class label.
rows.distinction: It supplies the MEASURED envelope that AdmitPlacement judges; CollectiveWitnessed is one boolean input inside that envelope, whereas this is the whole witnessed capacity record.

rows.definition: Exported accessor returning the current #4801 typed placement verdict, derived by AdmitPlacement from the witnessed envelope; the artifact #4788 gates its transfer on.
rows.distinction: It returns the derived VERDICT, whereas witnessedReservationEnvelope returns the raw witnessed capacity input it is derived from.

rows.definition: The #4801 placement constraint that accelerator capacity may only be counted when it is reachable WITHOUT displacing any peer workload, making eviction unavailable as a way to close a shortfall.
rows.distinction: It is a prohibition on eviction bounding a capacity read, not an eviction mechanism; the evict family's other terms name components that perform eviction, whereas this names the constraint that forbids it.
